  <script>
    let nrNotAcceptedSent = false;
    const ltpIds={header:'ltp-header',body:'ltp-terms',CTA:'ltp-submit-btn'};
    const brandMsg = { 'food': "Welcome to Food Network - we're excited to have you in our kitchen!  ", 'hgtv': "Welcome to HGTV - we're glad you're here! "};
    
    const ltpLang={'es':{ header: 'Términos legales y privacidad', body:'Al hacer clic en "Aceptar", usted confirma que ha leído y acepta nuestros <a href="https://www.wbd.com/discovery-visitor-agreement/" target="_blank">Términos de Uso</a>, y que consiente la recopilación y el uso de su información mediante cookies y tecnologías similares, tal como se establece en nuestra <a href="https://www.wbdprivacy.com/policycenter/b2c/" target="_blank">Política de privacidad</a>.',CTA:'Aceptar'}};
    let ltpService = {log(){}, setLTPCookie: ()=>{}, checkForLTPCookie: async ()=>{}, hasDSLTPAck: ()=>false, hasWBDLTPAck: ()=>false };
    SNI.Config = SNI.Config || {};
    SNI.Config.termsConfig.scripts = [
      { src: '//code.adsales.snidigital.com/datmcp/mcp-loader.js', name: 'MCP', onload(){ sniAdsStart(); }},
      { src: 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=AW-935057167', name: 'Google Ads', attr: 'async'},
      { src: '//assets.adobedtm.com/launch-ENe37f8b8d568443619b43fb72877cfc3d.min.js', name: 'Analytics', attr: 'async', onload(){
        SNILoadEvents.trigger('analytics-loaded');
      }},
      { src: 'https://assets.publicgood.com/pgm/v1/dpg.js', name: 'PG Ads', attr: 'defer'}
    ];

    // Set on page load
    function setLtpConsentNrAttr(ack='') {
      try {
        if (typeof isBot !== 'undefined' && isBot) return;
        if (typeof newrelic === 'object' && typeof newrelic.setCustomAttribute === 'function') {
          newrelic.setCustomAttribute('ltp-terms-pageview', ack.toString());
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log('NR Custom Metric', 'Unable to set LTP consent metric on this browser.');
        console.log('NR Custom Metric', 'Error:', e);
      }
    }

    /*
       Track Banner action by user
       This function runs anytime a user sees the LTP terms banner.  It is triggered to show acceptance when the user clicks to accept
       When a user leaves the page without accepting then this event is sent to false and should be interpreted as the "user left without accepting"
    */
    function setLtpConsentNrAction(ack){
      try {
        if (typeof isBot !== 'undefined' && isBot) return;
        if (typeof newrelic === 'object' && typeof newrelic.addPageAction === 'function') {
          newrelic.addPageAction('ltp-terms', {
           termsAccepted: ack
          });
          if (ltpService) {
            ltpService.log("NR Page Action. LTP terms accepted", ack);
          }
        }
       } catch (e) {
         console.log('NR Custom Page Action', 'Unable to set LTP consent metric on this browser.');
         console.log('NR Custom Page Action', 'Error:', e);
       }
    }

    // Log an event when a banner is displayed but the user navigates away from the page
    function onHiddenLTPEvent(){
      let ack = checkForAckTerms();
      if (document.hidden && ack && !nrNotAcceptedSent) {
        nrNotAcceptedSent = true;
        setLtpConsentNrAction(false)
      }
    }

    function checkForAckTerms(){
      return !isBot && window?.WBD?.UserConsent?.getAckTermsNeeded();
    }

    async function ltpStartUp() {
      let ltpFallback = false;
      if (SNI?.Application) {
        ltpService = SNI.Application.getService('legal-terms-acceptance');
      } else {
        // Fallback
        ltpFallback = true;
      }
      let reqAck;
      let showModal = false;
      let cachedLTPSession;
      let dsLTP = false;
      let dsLTPCrossSiteOK = false;
      let hasDSLTPAck;
      let hasWBDLTP;
      let syncTermsAck = false;
      if (SNI.Config.enableLTPMitigation) {
        hasWBDLTP = ltpService.hasWBDLTPAck(); // This check is only used to skip the mitigation logic, UCL is still started normally
        // Rely on UCL validation first, to avoid network calls
        if (!hasWBDLTP) {
          hasDSLTPAck = await ltpService.hasDSLTPAck(); // Checks in local storage, third-party cookie and finally for a referrer to detect a cross site consent
          if (hasDSLTPAck && hasDSLTPAck.status === 200) {
            syncTermsAck = true;  // when this is true then the UCL ack will also be set to true
            dsLTPCrossSiteOK = true;
          }
          // Fallback to no enforcement only when mitigation is enabled
          if (!dsLTPCrossSiteOK && hasDSLTPAck?.status === 400) {
            ltpFallback = true;
          }
        } else {
          // Since the WBD ack exists then also set DS LTP consent if it's not already set
          ltpService.setLTPCookie();
        }
        // Fallback when CoreJS fails checks
        if (ltpFallback) window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.ackTermsEnforce = false;
      } else {
        ltpService.log("Skip LTP modal mitigation");
      }
      window.WBD.UserConsent.init(window.SNI.UserConsentConfig);
      // Sync up the UCL terms ack to avoid displaying the modal on this brand
      if (syncTermsAck) {
        ltpService.log('Save WBD terms ACK from another site');
        window.WBD.UserConsent.ackTerms();
      }
      ltpService.log("Terms enforced (after checking consent and cross-site consent):", window.WBD.UserConsent.getAckTermsEnforced());
      // Finally, do we still need to display terms?
      reqAck = checkForAckTerms();
      ltpService.log("Terms show modal", reqAck);
      ltpService.log('Terms ack required:', reqAck, 'hasWBDLTP is set to:', hasWBDLTP, 'DS is set to:', hasDSLTPAck);

      // Set an attribute on the page view event.  Negate reqAck and use that as the current state of terms acknowledgement
      // Set a NR page view attribute called ltp-terms-pageview to reflect the current state of terms acceptance at page view.  If terms are accepted then ltp-terms-pageview will be true.
      setLtpConsentNrAttr(!reqAck);
      // The logic to load the modal is here
      if (reqAck) {
        showModal = true;
        ltpModal();
        ltpModalHandlers();
        // Set up EH to register terms not accepted
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onHiddenLTPEvent);
      } else {
        initLibs();
      }
    }

    function initLibs() {
      // Ads library and analytics here

      let ltpScriptConfigs = (SNI.Config?.termsConfig?.scripts ||[]).map(script=> {
        let config = {
          onload() {
            if (ltpService) ltpService.log('User Consent, added', script.name);
            if (script.onload) script.onload();
          },
          src: script.src
        };
        if (script.attr) config[script.attr] = true;
        return config;
      });

      // WM User Consent add scripts
      ltpScriptConfigs.forEach((config)=>{
        window?.WBD?.UserConsent?.addScript(config);
      });
    }

    function updateLang(content){
      
      const userLang = (window.navigator.language || 'en').substr(0, 2).toLowerCase();
      const lang = ltpLang[userLang];
      
      if (lang) {
        let sections = Object.keys(ltpIds);
        
        sections.map(el=>(
          {section: el, id: ltpIds[el]})).forEach(item=>{
          let elem = content.getElementById(item.id);
          elem.innerHTML = lang[item.section];
        });
        return { updated: true, userLang };
      }
      return { updated: false, userLang };
    }
    function addWelcomeMsg(content){
      const terms = content.getElementById('ltp-terms');
      const text = brandMsg[SNI.Config.brand];
      if (terms && text) terms.prepend(text);
    }
    
    function ltpModal() {
      const template = document.querySelector('#ltp-markup');
      const clone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
       
      let langUpdated = updateLang(clone);
      if (langUpdated.userLang === 'en') addWelcomeMsg(clone);
      document.body.appendChild(clone);
    }
    function ltpModalHandlers() {
      ltpOpenDialog();
      ltpHandleForm();
    }
    function ltpOpenDialog(){
      let modalDialog = document.querySelector('#ltp-dialog');
      document.body.classList.add('is-NoScroll');
      modalDialog.showModal();
    }
    function ltpHandleTermsFormSubmit(){
      const reloadDisabled = !!window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.reloadOnAckTerms;
      if (!isBot) setLtpConsentNrAction(true);
      // Save a third-party cookie when mitigation is enabled
      if (SNI.Config.enableLTPMitigation) {
        ltpService.setLTPCookie();
      }
      document.body.classList.remove('is-NoScroll');
      ltpService.log('Terms accepted.  UCL Ref:',  window.WBD?.referrer, 'browser ref:',  document.referrer);
      // Terms accepted
      window.WBD.UserConsent.ackTerms();
      // Save terms for analytics
      let ackTermsTime = window.WBD.UserConsent.getAckTermsTime();
      ltpService && ltpService?.analyticsAckTracking(ackTermsTime);
      // Init libs if the reload is disabled (i.e. set up ads and analytics now)
      if (reloadDisabled) initLibs();
    }
    function ltpHandleForm() {
      let modalDialogForm = document.querySelector('#ltp-submit');
      modalDialogForm.addEventListener('submit',ltpHandleTermsFormSubmit);
    }
    
    if (document.readyState !== 'complete') {
        
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ltpStartUp, false);
    } else {
        
        ltpStartUp();
    }
  </script>

    const ltpLang={'es':{ header: 'Términos legales y privacidad', body:'Al hacer clic en "Aceptar", usted confirma que ha leído y acepta nuestros <a href="https://www.wbd.com/discovery-visitor-agreement/" target="_blank">Términos de Uso</a>, y que consiente la recopilación y el uso de su información mediante cookies y tecnologías similares, tal como se establece en nuestra <a href="https://www.wbdprivacy.com/policycenter/b2c/" target="_blank">Política de privacidad</a>.',CTA:'Aceptar'}};
    let ltpService = {log(){}, setLTPCookie: ()=>{}, checkForLTPCookie: async ()=>{}, hasDSLTPAck: ()=>false, hasWBDLTPAck: ()=>false };
    SNI.Config = SNI.Config || {};
    SNI.Config.termsConfig.scripts = [
      { src: '//code.adsales.snidigital.com/datmcp/mcp-loader.js', name: 'MCP', onload(){ sniAdsStart(); }},
      { src: 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=AW-935057167', name: 'Google Ads', attr: 'async'},
      { src: '//assets.adobedtm.com/launch-ENe37f8b8d568443619b43fb72877cfc3d.min.js', name: 'Analytics', attr: 'async', onload(){
        SNILoadEvents.trigger('analytics-loaded');
      }},
      { src: 'https://assets.publicgood.com/pgm/v1/dpg.js', name: 'PG Ads', attr: 'defer'}
    ];

    // Set on page load
    function setLtpConsentNrAttr(ack='') {
      try {
        if (typeof isBot !== 'undefined' && isBot) return;
        if (typeof newrelic === 'object' && typeof newrelic.setCustomAttribute === 'function') {
          newrelic.setCustomAttribute('ltp-terms-pageview', ack.toString());
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log('NR Custom Metric', 'Unable to set LTP consent metric on this browser.');
        console.log('NR Custom Metric', 'Error:', e);
      }
    }

    /*
       Track Banner action by user
       This function runs anytime a user sees the LTP terms banner.  It is triggered to show acceptance when the user clicks to accept
       When a user leaves the page without accepting then this event is sent to false and should be interpreted as the "user left without accepting"
    */
    function setLtpConsentNrAction(ack){
      try {
        if (typeof isBot !== 'undefined' && isBot) return;
        if (typeof newrelic === 'object' && typeof newrelic.addPageAction === 'function') {
          newrelic.addPageAction('ltp-terms', {
           termsAccepted: ack
          });
          if (ltpService) {
            ltpService.log("NR Page Action. LTP terms accepted", ack);
          }
        }
       } catch (e) {
         console.log('NR Custom Page Action', 'Unable to set LTP consent metric on this browser.');
         console.log('NR Custom Page Action', 'Error:', e);
       }
    }

    // Log an event when a banner is displayed but the user navigates away from the page
    function onHiddenLTPEvent(){
      let ack = checkForAckTerms();
      if (document.hidden && ack && !nrNotAcceptedSent) {
        nrNotAcceptedSent = true;
        setLtpConsentNrAction(false)
      }
    }

    function checkForAckTerms(){
      return !isBot && window?.WBD?.UserConsent?.getAckTermsNeeded();
    }

    async function ltpStartUp() {
      let ltpFallback = false;
      if (SNI?.Application) {
        ltpService = SNI.Application.getService('legal-terms-acceptance');
      } else {
        // Fallback
        ltpFallback = true;
      }
      let reqAck;
      let showModal = false;
      let cachedLTPSession;
      let dsLTP = false;
      let dsLTPCrossSiteOK = false;
      let hasDSLTPAck;
      let hasWBDLTP;
      let syncTermsAck = false;
      if (SNI.Config.enableLTPMitigation) {
        hasWBDLTP = ltpService.hasWBDLTPAck(); // This check is only used to skip the mitigation logic, UCL is still started normally
        // Rely on UCL validation first, to avoid network calls
        if (!hasWBDLTP) {
          hasDSLTPAck = await ltpService.hasDSLTPAck(); // Checks in local storage, third-party cookie and finally for a referrer to detect a cross site consent
          if (hasDSLTPAck && hasDSLTPAck.status === 200) {
            syncTermsAck = true;  // when this is true then the UCL ack will also be set to true
            dsLTPCrossSiteOK = true;
          }
          // Fallback to no enforcement only when mitigation is enabled
          if (!dsLTPCrossSiteOK && hasDSLTPAck?.status === 400) {
            ltpFallback = true;
          }
        } else {
          // Since the WBD ack exists then also set DS LTP consent if it's not already set
          ltpService.setLTPCookie();
        }
        // Fallback when CoreJS fails checks
        if (ltpFallback) window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.ackTermsEnforce = false;
      } else {
        ltpService.log("Skip LTP modal mitigation");
      }
      window.WBD.UserConsent.init(window.SNI.UserConsentConfig);
      // Sync up the UCL terms ack to avoid displaying the modal on this brand
      if (syncTermsAck) {
        ltpService.log('Save WBD terms ACK from another site');
        window.WBD.UserConsent.ackTerms();
      }
      ltpService.log("Terms enforced (after checking consent and cross-site consent):", window.WBD.UserConsent.getAckTermsEnforced());
      // Finally, do we still need to display terms?
      reqAck = checkForAckTerms();
      ltpService.log("Terms show modal", reqAck);
      ltpService.log('Terms ack required:', reqAck, 'hasWBDLTP is set to:', hasWBDLTP, 'DS is set to:', hasDSLTPAck);

      // Set an attribute on the page view event.  Negate reqAck and use that as the current state of terms acknowledgement
      // Set a NR page view attribute called ltp-terms-pageview to reflect the current state of terms acceptance at page view.  If terms are accepted then ltp-terms-pageview will be true.
      setLtpConsentNrAttr(!reqAck);
      // The logic to load the modal is here
      if (reqAck) {
        showModal = true;
        ltpModal();
        ltpModalHandlers();
        // Set up EH to register terms not accepted
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onHiddenLTPEvent);
      } else {
        initLibs();
      }
    }

    function initLibs() {
      // Ads library and analytics here

      let ltpScriptConfigs = (SNI.Config?.termsConfig?.scripts ||[]).map(script=> {
        let config = {
          onload() {
            if (ltpService) ltpService.log('User Consent, added', script.name);
            if (script.onload) script.onload();
          },
          src: script.src
        };
        if (script.attr) config[script.attr] = true;
        return config;
      });

      // WM User Consent add scripts
      ltpScriptConfigs.forEach((config)=>{
        window?.WBD?.UserConsent?.addScript(config);
      });
    }

    function updateLang(content){
      
      const userLang = (window.navigator.language || 'en').substr(0, 2).toLowerCase();
      const lang = ltpLang[userLang];
      
      if (lang) {
        let sections = Object.keys(ltpIds);
        
        sections.map(el=>(
          {section: el, id: ltpIds[el]})).forEach(item=>{
          let elem = content.getElementById(item.id);
          elem.innerHTML = lang[item.section];
        });
        return { updated: true, userLang };
      }
      return { updated: false, userLang };
    }
    function addWelcomeMsg(content){
      const terms = content.getElementById('ltp-terms');
      const text = brandMsg[SNI.Config.brand];
      if (terms && text) terms.prepend(text);
    }
    
    function ltpModal() {
      const template = document.querySelector('#ltp-markup');
      const clone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
       
      let langUpdated = updateLang(clone);
      if (langUpdated.userLang === 'en') addWelcomeMsg(clone);
      document.body.appendChild(clone);
    }
    function ltpModalHandlers() {
      ltpOpenDialog();
      ltpHandleForm();
    }
    function ltpOpenDialog(){
      let modalDialog = document.querySelector('#ltp-dialog');
      document.body.classList.add('is-NoScroll');
      modalDialog.showModal();
    }
    function ltpHandleTermsFormSubmit(){
      const reloadDisabled = !!window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.reloadOnAckTerms;
      if (!isBot) setLtpConsentNrAction(true);
      // Save a third-party cookie when mitigation is enabled
      if (SNI.Config.enableLTPMitigation) {
        ltpService.setLTPCookie();
      }
      document.body.classList.remove('is-NoScroll');
      ltpService.log('Terms accepted.  UCL Ref:',  window.WBD?.referrer, 'browser ref:',  document.referrer);
      // Terms accepted
      window.WBD.UserConsent.ackTerms();
      // Save terms for analytics
      let ackTermsTime = window.WBD.UserConsent.getAckTermsTime();
      ltpService && ltpService?.analyticsAckTracking(ackTermsTime);
      // Init libs if the reload is disabled (i.e. set up ads and analytics now)
      if (reloadDisabled) initLibs();
    }
    function ltpHandleForm() {
      let modalDialogForm = document.querySelector('#ltp-submit');
      modalDialogForm.addEventListener('submit',ltpHandleTermsFormSubmit);
    }
    
    if (document.readyState !== 'complete') {
        
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ltpStartUp, false);
    } else {
        
        ltpStartUp();
    }
  </script>

          hasDSLTPAck = await ltpService.hasDSLTPAck(); // Checks in local storage, third-party cookie and finally for a referrer to detect a cross site consent
          if (hasDSLTPAck && hasDSLTPAck.status === 200) {
            syncTermsAck = true;  // when this is true then the UCL ack will also be set to true
            dsLTPCrossSiteOK = true;
          }
          // Fallback to no enforcement only when mitigation is enabled
          if (!dsLTPCrossSiteOK && hasDSLTPAck?.status === 400) {
            ltpFallback = true;
          }
        } else {
          // Since the WBD ack exists then also set DS LTP consent if it's not already set
          ltpService.setLTPCookie();
        }
        // Fallback when CoreJS fails checks
        if (ltpFallback) window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.ackTermsEnforce = false;
      } else {
        ltpService.log("Skip LTP modal mitigation");
      }
      window.WBD.UserConsent.init(window.SNI.UserConsentConfig);
      // Sync up the UCL terms ack to avoid displaying the modal on this brand
      if (syncTermsAck) {
        ltpService.log('Save WBD terms ACK from another site');
        window.WBD.UserConsent.ackTerms();
      }
      ltpService.log("Terms enforced (after checking consent and cross-site consent):", window.WBD.UserConsent.getAckTermsEnforced());
      // Finally, do we still need to display terms?
      reqAck = checkForAckTerms();
      ltpService.log("Terms show modal", reqAck);
      ltpService.log('Terms ack required:', reqAck, 'hasWBDLTP is set to:', hasWBDLTP, 'DS is set to:', hasDSLTPAck);

      // Set an attribute on the page view event.  Negate reqAck and use that as the current state of terms acknowledgement
      // Set a NR page view attribute called ltp-terms-pageview to reflect the current state of terms acceptance at page view.  If terms are accepted then ltp-terms-pageview will be true.
      setLtpConsentNrAttr(!reqAck);
      // The logic to load the modal is here
      if (reqAck) {
        showModal = true;
        ltpModal();
        ltpModalHandlers();
        // Set up EH to register terms not accepted
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onHiddenLTPEvent);
      } else {
        initLibs();
      }
    }

    function initLibs() {
      // Ads library and analytics here

      let ltpScriptConfigs = (SNI.Config?.termsConfig?.scripts ||[]).map(script=> {
        let config = {
          onload() {
            if (ltpService) ltpService.log('User Consent, added', script.name);
            if (script.onload) script.onload();
          },
          src: script.src
        };
        if (script.attr) config[script.attr] = true;
        return config;
      });

      // WM User Consent add scripts
      ltpScriptConfigs.forEach((config)=>{
        window?.WBD?.UserConsent?.addScript(config);
      });
    }

    function updateLang(content){
      
      const userLang = (window.navigator.language || 'en').substr(0, 2).toLowerCase();
      const lang = ltpLang[userLang];
      
      if (lang) {
        let sections = Object.keys(ltpIds);
        
        sections.map(el=>(
          {section: el, id: ltpIds[el]})).forEach(item=>{
          let elem = content.getElementById(item.id);
          elem.innerHTML = lang[item.section];
        });
        return { updated: true, userLang };
      }
      return { updated: false, userLang };
    }
    function addWelcomeMsg(content){
      const terms = content.getElementById('ltp-terms');
      const text = brandMsg[SNI.Config.brand];
      if (terms && text) terms.prepend(text);
    }
    
    function ltpModal() {
      const template = document.querySelector('#ltp-markup');
      const clone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
       
      let langUpdated = updateLang(clone);
      if (langUpdated.userLang === 'en') addWelcomeMsg(clone);
      document.body.appendChild(clone);
    }
    function ltpModalHandlers() {
      ltpOpenDialog();
      ltpHandleForm();
    }
    function ltpOpenDialog(){
      let modalDialog = document.querySelector('#ltp-dialog');
      document.body.classList.add('is-NoScroll');
      modalDialog.showModal();
    }
    function ltpHandleTermsFormSubmit(){
      const reloadDisabled = !!window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.reloadOnAckTerms;
      if (!isBot) setLtpConsentNrAction(true);
      // Save a third-party cookie when mitigation is enabled
      if (SNI.Config.enableLTPMitigation) {
        ltpService.setLTPCookie();
      }
      document.body.classList.remove('is-NoScroll');
      ltpService.log('Terms accepted.  UCL Ref:',  window.WBD?.referrer, 'browser ref:',  document.referrer);
      // Terms accepted
      window.WBD.UserConsent.ackTerms();
      // Save terms for analytics
      let ackTermsTime = window.WBD.UserConsent.getAckTermsTime();
      ltpService && ltpService?.analyticsAckTracking(ackTermsTime);
      // Init libs if the reload is disabled (i.e. set up ads and analytics now)
      if (reloadDisabled) initLibs();
    }
    function ltpHandleForm() {
      let modalDialogForm = document.querySelector('#ltp-submit');
      modalDialogForm.addEventListener('submit',ltpHandleTermsFormSubmit);
    }
    
    if (document.readyState !== 'complete') {
        
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ltpStartUp, false);
    } else {
        
        ltpStartUp();
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    let nrNotAcceptedSent = false;
    const ltpIds={header:'ltp-header',body:'ltp-terms',CTA:'ltp-submit-btn'};
    const brandMsg = { 'food': "Welcome to Food Network - we're excited to have you in our kitchen!  ", 'hgtv': "Welcome to HGTV - we're glad you're here! "};
    
    const ltpLang={'es':{ header: 'Términos legales y privacidad', body:'Al hacer clic en "Aceptar", usted confirma que ha leído y acepta nuestros <a href="https://www.wbd.com/discovery-visitor-agreement/" target="_blank">Términos de Uso</a>, y que consiente la recopilación y el uso de su información mediante cookies y tecnologías similares, tal como se establece en nuestra <a href="https://www.wbdprivacy.com/policycenter/b2c/" target="_blank">Política de privacidad</a>.',CTA:'Aceptar'}};
    let ltpService = {log(){}, setLTPCookie: ()=>{}, checkForLTPCookie: async ()=>{}, hasDSLTPAck: ()=>false, hasWBDLTPAck: ()=>false };
    SNI.Config = SNI.Config || {};
    SNI.Config.termsConfig.scripts = [
      { src: '//code.adsales.snidigital.com/datmcp/mcp-loader.js', name: 'MCP', onload(){ sniAdsStart(); }},
      { src: 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=AW-935057167', name: 'Google Ads', attr: 'async'},
      { src: '//assets.adobedtm.com/launch-ENe37f8b8d568443619b43fb72877cfc3d.min.js', name: 'Analytics', attr: 'async', onload(){
        SNILoadEvents.trigger('analytics-loaded');
      }},
      { src: 'https://assets.publicgood.com/pgm/v1/dpg.js', name: 'PG Ads', attr: 'defer'}
    ];

    // Set on page load
    function setLtpConsentNrAttr(ack='') {
      try {
        if (typeof isBot !== 'undefined' && isBot) return;
        if (typeof newrelic === 'object' && typeof newrelic.setCustomAttribute === 'function') {
          newrelic.setCustomAttribute('ltp-terms-pageview', ack.toString());
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log('NR Custom Metric', 'Unable to set LTP consent metric on this browser.');
        console.log('NR Custom Metric', 'Error:', e);
      }
    }

    /*
       Track Banner action by user
       This function runs anytime a user sees the LTP terms banner.  It is triggered to show acceptance when the user clicks to accept
       When a user leaves the page without accepting then this event is sent to false and should be interpreted as the "user left without accepting"
    */
    function setLtpConsentNrAction(ack){
      try {
        if (typeof isBot !== 'undefined' && isBot) return;
        if (typeof newrelic === 'object' && typeof newrelic.addPageAction === 'function') {
          newrelic.addPageAction('ltp-terms', {
           termsAccepted: ack
          });
          if (ltpService) {
            ltpService.log("NR Page Action. LTP terms accepted", ack);
          }
        }
       } catch (e) {
         console.log('NR Custom Page Action', 'Unable to set LTP consent metric on this browser.');
         console.log('NR Custom Page Action', 'Error:', e);
       }
    }

    // Log an event when a banner is displayed but the user navigates away from the page
    function onHiddenLTPEvent(){
      let ack = checkForAckTerms();
      if (document.hidden && ack && !nrNotAcceptedSent) {
        nrNotAcceptedSent = true;
        setLtpConsentNrAction(false)
      }
    }

    function checkForAckTerms(){
      return !isBot && window?.WBD?.UserConsent?.getAckTermsNeeded();
    }

    async function ltpStartUp() {
      let ltpFallback = false;
      if (SNI?.Application) {
        ltpService = SNI.Application.getService('legal-terms-acceptance');
      } else {
        // Fallback
        ltpFallback = true;
      }
      let reqAck;
      let showModal = false;
      let cachedLTPSession;
      let dsLTP = false;
      let dsLTPCrossSiteOK = false;
      let hasDSLTPAck;
      let hasWBDLTP;
      let syncTermsAck = false;
      if (SNI.Config.enableLTPMitigation) {
        hasWBDLTP = ltpService.hasWBDLTPAck(); // This check is only used to skip the mitigation logic, UCL is still started normally
        // Rely on UCL validation first, to avoid network calls
        if (!hasWBDLTP) {
          hasDSLTPAck = await ltpService.hasDSLTPAck(); // Checks in local storage, third-party cookie and finally for a referrer to detect a cross site consent
          if (hasDSLTPAck && hasDSLTPAck.status === 200) {
            syncTermsAck = true;  // when this is true then the UCL ack will also be set to true
            dsLTPCrossSiteOK = true;
          }
          // Fallback to no enforcement only when mitigation is enabled
          if (!dsLTPCrossSiteOK && hasDSLTPAck?.status === 400) {
            ltpFallback = true;
          }
        } else {
          // Since the WBD ack exists then also set DS LTP consent if it's not already set
          ltpService.setLTPCookie();
        }
        // Fallback when CoreJS fails checks
        if (ltpFallback) window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.ackTermsEnforce = false;
      } else {
        ltpService.log("Skip LTP modal mitigation");
      }
      window.WBD.UserConsent.init(window.SNI.UserConsentConfig);
      // Sync up the UCL terms ack to avoid displaying the modal on this brand
      if (syncTermsAck) {
        ltpService.log('Save WBD terms ACK from another site');
        window.WBD.UserConsent.ackTerms();
      }
      ltpService.log("Terms enforced (after checking consent and cross-site consent):", window.WBD.UserConsent.getAckTermsEnforced());
      // Finally, do we still need to display terms?
      reqAck = checkForAckTerms();
      ltpService.log("Terms show modal", reqAck);
      ltpService.log('Terms ack required:', reqAck, 'hasWBDLTP is set to:', hasWBDLTP, 'DS is set to:', hasDSLTPAck);

      // Set an attribute on the page view event.  Negate reqAck and use that as the current state of terms acknowledgement
      // Set a NR page view attribute called ltp-terms-pageview to reflect the current state of terms acceptance at page view.  If terms are accepted then ltp-terms-pageview will be true.
      setLtpConsentNrAttr(!reqAck);
      // The logic to load the modal is here
      if (reqAck) {
        showModal = true;
        ltpModal();
        ltpModalHandlers();
        // Set up EH to register terms not accepted
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onHiddenLTPEvent);
      } else {
        initLibs();
      }
    }

    function initLibs() {
      // Ads library and analytics here

      let ltpScriptConfigs = (SNI.Config?.termsConfig?.scripts ||[]).map(script=> {
        let config = {
          onload() {
            if (ltpService) ltpService.log('User Consent, added', script.name);
            if (script.onload) script.onload();
          },
          src: script.src
        };
        if (script.attr) config[script.attr] = true;
        return config;
      });

      // WM User Consent add scripts
      ltpScriptConfigs.forEach((config)=>{
        window?.WBD?.UserConsent?.addScript(config);
      });
    }

    function updateLang(content){
      
      const userLang = (window.navigator.language || 'en').substr(0, 2).toLowerCase();
      const lang = ltpLang[userLang];
      
      if (lang) {
        let sections = Object.keys(ltpIds);
        
        sections.map(el=>(
          {section: el, id: ltpIds[el]})).forEach(item=>{
          let elem = content.getElementById(item.id);
          elem.innerHTML = lang[item.section];
        });
        return { updated: true, userLang };
      }
      return { updated: false, userLang };
    }
    function addWelcomeMsg(content){
      const terms = content.getElementById('ltp-terms');
      const text = brandMsg[SNI.Config.brand];
      if (terms && text) terms.prepend(text);
    }
    
    function ltpModal() {
      const template = document.querySelector('#ltp-markup');
      const clone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
       
      let langUpdated = updateLang(clone);
      if (langUpdated.userLang === 'en') addWelcomeMsg(clone);
      document.body.appendChild(clone);
    }
    function ltpModalHandlers() {
      ltpOpenDialog();
      ltpHandleForm();
    }
    function ltpOpenDialog(){
      let modalDialog = document.querySelector('#ltp-dialog');
      document.body.classList.add('is-NoScroll');
      modalDialog.showModal();
    }
    function ltpHandleTermsFormSubmit(){
      const reloadDisabled = !!window.SNI.UserConsentConfig.reloadOnAckTerms;
      if (!isBot) setLtpConsentNrAction(true);
      // Save a third-party cookie when mitigation is enabled
      if (SNI.Config.enableLTPMitigation) {
        ltpService.setLTPCookie();
      }
      document.body.classList.remove('is-NoScroll');
      ltpService.log('Terms accepted.  UCL Ref:',  window.WBD?.referrer, 'browser ref:',  document.referrer);
